title: frances voltalia wins approval 35 billion data center project brazil 2026 08 27
text:
SAO PAULO, Aug 27 (Reuters) - French renewable energy company Voltalia (VLTSA.PA)

 has received authorization from Brazil's government ​to install a data center at the ‌Pecem port complex in Ceara state, securing tax exemptions for the planned mega-project.
